resources.string: This app is part of your pause. It is available again when the pause ends.
Pauses and schedules work while the app is closed.

During a pause, Posato checks which app is open so that it can cover an app you chose. It reads only the app in front, only on this phone, and never sends it anywhere. Next, Android opens Usage access: switch Posato on there.
During a pause, Posato shows its pause screen over an app you chose until you leave it. It shows nothing else over other apps. Next, Android opens Display over other apps: switch Posato on there.
